root_cause.hypothesis: Application code path querying warden_proving_ground (a COUNT(*) check, likely a gate/limit check) opens a transaction and never commits or closes it, leaving connections stuck idle-in-transaction. Repeated identical query across 10 pids points to a connection/session leak in one code path (e.g., missing commit/close or exception swallowed before cleanup) rather than a slow query or lock contention.
evidence: 10 distinct pids all idle_in_transaction ~333-336s on identical query SELECT count(*) FROM warden_proving_ground
idle_in_transaction=12 but long_running_queries=0 and locks_waiting=0 — transactions are idle, not executing or blocked
connections_used_pct only 25% — not pool exhaustion yet, early-stage leak
no recent deploys listed, so likely pre-existing/intermittent bug triggered by load or specific input, not a new regression
ruled_out: Slow/expensive query itself (long_running_queries=0, query is a simple count)
Recent deploy as trigger (deploy list empty)
